summary: Grupo Financiero Galicia S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the payment of the first installment of a cash dividend announced on June 30, 2026, per shareholder approval from April 28, 2026. The dividend installment amounts to Ps. 13,333,257,333.33, payable to shareholders of record as of July 6, 2026, with an effective date of July 13, 2026. This is a routine capital distribution event, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other extraordinary corporate action is involved. As a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, this filing is a standard dividend notification with no special-situation characteristics.
